description: Stores the customer's own Reddit session once, so the comment, submit, vote and DM tools in this server act as that account without cookies in later calls. The session is kept server-side, encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key held only by the API), against this API key's account, after a check with Reddit: a logged-out session is refused with SESSION_LOGGED_OUT. Takes Reddit's session and loid cookies (from the REST login endpoint or the customer's own browser), plus the CSRF cookie for voting and messaging. Connecting again replaces the stored session. Free.

csrf_token.description: The CSRF cookie. Needed for voting and messaging.

token_v2.description: The token_v2 cookie, when the session has one.
